recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It preserves the issue's intent by making the BMI example point at the current Body Height Observation example; if a future rendered build still fails to link Observation/body-height correctly, review the example link-generation machinery rather than pointing the Observation reference at the bodyheight StructureDefinition profile id.
issue_request: FHIR-14494 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Observation issue raised against STU3. It reported that the BMI example's Observation.derivedFrom link for Body-height pointed to a build.fhir.org page that returned 404, and the auto-approved correction was to fix the broken link.
initial_application: Git commit 434f3796a2aa327c947bf2e20c1598d93d0de7da appears to be the historical application: it changed the BMI example's first derivedFrom reference from Observation/body-height with display Body-height to Observation/bodyheight with display Body Height. No later commit explicitly named FHIR-14494.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source-backed Body Height Observation example has id body-height with an active list-Observation-examples.xml entry for Observation/body-height. The similarly named StructureDefinition/bodyheight is a vital-sign profile, not an Observation resource target. A related Jira search found FHIR-29109 about BMI derivedFrom in FHIR-us-vitals, but that belongs to a separate specification. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive community discussion that changes the source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/observation-example-bmi-using-related.xml so the first derivedFrom reference now points to Observation/body-height instead of the unmatched Observation/bodyheight.
source_changes: source/observation/observation-example-bmi-using-related.xml: changed the first Observation.derivedFrom reference from Observation/bodyheight to Observation/body-height.

related_jiras.note: Later FHIR-us-vitals issue also discusses BMI Observation.derivedFrom for height and weight profiles, but it belongs to a separate specification and was not decided or changed in this FHIR-core reconciliation.
